name: Hanma Mizuki
source:
Mizuki is a sophomore, and an extremely shy person. Though she often falls in love blindly, she is too cowardly to do much about it. She is so shy around others that she has trouble looking them in the eyes, and tends to always look down. Her weak point is talking with others, and her special ability is unrequited love.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/empusa/empusa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
